# Lightfast Digital (Pty) Ltd

> Lightfast Digital (Pty) Ltd is a South African software company that builds and
> operates its own products. Registration number 2026/652553/07, registered 2026-08-17,
> based in Cape Town, South Africa.

## Products

- POPIAdesk: POPIA compliance software for South African small businesses - readiness
  assessments, required documents, breach procedures, and ongoing compliance tracking.
  https://popiadesk.co.za
- VetGuard: a free, open-source, local-first scanner for npm supply-chain threats
  created by AI-assisted development - hallucinated (slopsquatted) dependencies,
  typosquats, and freshly registered malicious packages.
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/vetguard
